name: PT Bumi Teknokultura Unggul Tbk
summary: PT Bumi Teknokultura Unggul Tbk, through its subsidiary, PT Golden Harvest Cocoa Indonesia, engages in processing of cocoa bean in Indonesia and internationally. The company offers cocoa butter, cocoa cake, and cocoa paste. It also engages in real estate and construction, services, trading, industry, mining, plantations, agriculture, and forest exploitation and support services. The company serves consumer goods, food, and beverage industries. PT Bumi Teknokultura Unggul Tbk was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Jakarta Timur, Indonesia.
